During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a conflict fought in [[3996 BBY]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] '''attacked''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]].<ref name="TEA" />

==The attack==
Following the failed [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Sith War)|invasion]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], flashpoints ignited across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] strategy during this period of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] aimed at attacking various points along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], such as the [[Kemplex Nine]] [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|jump station]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and the [[Vento system/Legends|Vento system]] [[Vento system shipyards|shipyards]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" />

In the aftermath of [[Aleema Keto]]'s [[Battle of Kemplex Nine|attack]] on Kemplex Nine, in the [[Cron system]] of the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]],<ref name="TSW4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 4]]</ref> the Sith struck at Belderone,<ref name="TEA" /> in the neighboring [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]].<ref name="ORS">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Following the attack on Belderone, the Sith led an [[Attack on the Vento system shipyards|attack]] on the Vento [[Star system/Legends|system]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]].<ref name="TEA" />
